name: file_write
title: Write File
description: Creates, replaces, or appends bounded UTF-8 content on an explicitly selected HHC client after host-policy admission. Use for whole-content writes; prefer file_edit for precise changes to existing text.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to write on the selected client.

mode.description: create fails if the file exists; replace overwrites; append adds to the end.

expected_sha256.description: Only write if the current file content hashes to this SHA-256 (optimistic concurrency).

create_parents.description: Create missing parent directories as needed.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
